symbols.name: transform length
symbols.meaning: The number of ring elements along one axis of the transform, a power of two dividing 2r.
symbols.quote: Let $t$ be the transform length, the number of ring elements along one axis, a power of two dividing $2r$.

symbols.name: ring root of unity
symbols.meaning: The power y^{2r/t} of the ring variable, used as the root of unity of the length-t synthetic transform.

relations.quote: A synthetic polynomial transform is a transform over the [Polynomial ring modulo y^r + 1](ring-y.md) whose roots of unity are powers of $y$, so every twiddle multiplication (multiplication by a root of unity) is a signed shift of a coefficient list.

relations.quote: The synthetic transforms are given by the formulas of the [Discrete Fourier transform](dft.md), with $\omega_t$ in place of $e^{2\pi i/q}$:
As in the complex case, $F_t^-$ is computed by the layered scheme of [Butterflies and the fast transform](butterfly.md) in $\log_2 t$ layers of two-point averaging and differencing steps.
